headline: DARPA Backs Project to Measure AI Energy Consumption Across Workflows
summary: DARPA is backing a new project aimed at measuring artificial intelligence energy use across every stage of the workflow, addressing surging energy demand driven by data center expansion.
why: DARPA is the United States Department of Defense agency tasked with developing emerging technologies for military and national security applications, increasingly focusing on critical infrastructure challenges like energy grid strain.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: DARPA-backed measurement initiatives target energy tracking across AI workflows.
